scope: Release-safe audit of abstract, contribution, conclusion, and high-visibility quantitative paper claims.

headline_claims.privacy_boundary: Aggregate scale is public; row-level replay requires the external full HIB-Real release bundle.

headline_claims.claim_summary: CCD reaches 93.5% TPR at the 1e-4 FPR operating point while staying within the 0.60 ms full-path latency budget.
headline_claims.privacy_boundary: Aggregate accuracy and timing are public; raw replay predictions and serving traces are external.

headline_claims.claim_summary: The live comparison found 850 CCD-only verified positives missed by deployed Regex/WAF controls.
headline_claims.privacy_boundary: Aggregate overlap cells are public; row-level live case chains are masked or external.

headline_claims.claim_summary: The resolved replay contains 199,889,499 benign labels, 363,401 verified positives, and 86,986 unresolved rows; positives are about 0.18% of resolved replay rows.
headline_claims.privacy_boundary: Label totals are aggregate and release-safe; row-level labels require the external full release.

headline_claims.claim_summary: At K=6, CCD reports stable decisions for 98% of detected positives, with SEC alone at 60% and native-feature baselines at 41-48%.
headline_claims.privacy_boundary: Certificate implementation is public; paper-scale coverage counts are release-safe aggregates.

headline_claims.claim_summary: LLM-prior synthetic training is within 2.4 points of real-payload training at 1e-4 FPR, and tuned synthetic features reduce the gap to 1.2 points.
headline_claims.privacy_boundary: Aggregate generator comparison is public; full run outputs and real-payload training provenance are external.

headline_claims.claim_summary: Scope checks cover a 50-repo source corpus and map 118 of 127 post-freeze public reports to target categories.
headline_claims.privacy_boundary: Aggregate scope counts are public; full corpus labels and private review notes are external.

headline_claims.claim_summary: Across hostile-mimicry suites, CCD keeps 91.5-99.2% recall at 1e-4 FPR while strongest baselines range from 45.8-85.4%.
headline_claims.privacy_boundary: Aggregate stress-suite cells are public; row-level stress cases and predictions are external.

headline_claims.claim_summary: CCD's full production path reports 1.84/3.92/7.80 ms p95/p99/p99.9 latency and 48k host strings/s per host.
headline_claims.privacy_boundary: Production timing aggregates are public; raw serving traces and topology are external.
